game: PHI @ TB Week 4 2025, kickoff 2025-09-28 13:00 ET, TB +3.5, total 44.5, outdoors

script.base: Market expects a competitive PHI lead, not a shootout: PHI implied 24.0, TB 20.5, spread only 3.5, total 44.5. PHI leans on Saquon Barkley (58 car, 194 yds, 3.34 YPC) and Jalen Hurts (26 car, 123 yds) to stay in front. With Mike Evans out, TB throws to stay in range through Emeka Egbuka and Sterling Shepard rather than a clock-killing run game.
script.flip1: Baker Mayfield (biceps, questionable) sits or is snap-limited, and/or Tristan Wirfs (knee, questionable) sits. TB stalls under 20.5, PHI runs the clock, Barkley carries rise, and Egbuka/Shepard yards die.
script.flip2: PHI's run bleed (5.06 YPC, 12 runs of 10+) lets Bucky Irving and Mayfield runs keep TB level or ahead. PHI then abandons the run, Barkley's rush line dies, and both passing games rise only if the quarterbacks stay healthy.

injury_fallout: TB WR Mike Evans is Out (hamstring) after 28 targets, 140 yards and 333 air yards in three games, about 9.3 targets and 111 air yards per game off the board (30% of 92 listed TB targets). Chris Godwin Jr. is Questionable (ankle) and has zero targets in the weeks 1-3 target list, so he is not an established absorber. Next men are Egbuka (21 tgt, 181 yds, 244 air, 8.6 YPT) and Shepard (15 tgt, 153 yds, 154 air, 10.2 YPT). Cade Otton (7 tgt, 25 yds, 3.6 YPT) is a weak absorber. Mayfield Questionable (biceps) and Wirfs Questionable (knee) can erase the TB plan. TB S Christian Izien is Out (quad), which would help PHI deep shots, but no chart says who he played over. PHI CB Adoree' Jackson is Doubtful (groin), a mild help to TB WRs. TB DE Logan Hall is Questionable (groin). Sources: pack official pre-game injury report and weeks 1-3 target/rush lines. Final inactives about 90 minutes before kick are not in the pack.

matchup.shell: No coverage charting in the pack, so MOFO/MOFC and man/zone rates are unknown. Location only: TB defense YPA left 5.17 (41 att), middle 6.41 (17), right 8.86 (43). PHI defense YPA left 5.70 (37), middle 6.67 (21), right 5.95 (37).
matchup.pressure: TB blitzes 37%. PHI EPA/db is -0.16 vs blitz and +0.18 with no blitz, so TB pressure should kill PHI deep yards and push Hurts toward Barkley and Dallas Goedert checkdowns. PHI blitzes 30%. TB EPA/db is 0.27 vs blitz and 0.25 with no blitz, so Mayfield has not been hurt by blitz in three games.
matchup.bleeds: PHI run defense is the clear bleed: 5.06 YPC and 12 runs of 10+, with only 7 passes of 20+ (98 yds). TB run defense is sound at 3.79 YPC and 6 runs of 10+. TB pass defense bleeds the right side (8.86 YPA on 43 throws) and has allowed 9 passes of 20+ (109 yds).
matchup.overlap: The on-paper overlap is TB's run game (Irving 56 car at 3.11 YPC, Rachaad White 5.35 YPC on only 17 car, Mayfield 10/118) into PHI's 5.06 YPC run defense, but that fights the +3.5 dog-throws script. The usable overlap is Evans' vacated targets landing on Shepard and Egbuka, with a small assist only if Jackson is inactive. Izien out would overlap A.J. Brown/DeVonta Smith deep shots into TB's right-side bleed, but alignment is not charted and TB's blitz profile cuts against those overs.

form: Three-game window only. Shepard receiving yards 39, 34, 80 (median 39, mean 51); the 80 is a spike risk and the other two sit under 39.5. Egbuka 67, 29, 85 (median 67, mean 60.3) is already TB's most productive WR with Evans active. Irving rush 37, 71, 66 on 3.11 YPC, receiving 8, 50, 33. Barkley rush 60, 88, 46 (mean 64.7) with Hurts taking 26 carries at 4.7 YPC. Brown 8, 27, 109 is one-game inflated (109 of 144 yards). Smith 16, 53, 60 is trending up into a 53.5 median line. Goedert 44, 33 sits on 38.5. No similar-defense comps or coverage charts in the pack.

pro_edge.implied_totals: PHI (44.5+3.5)/2 = 24.0; TB (44.5-3.5)/2 = 20.5. Matches the precomputed scan.
pro_edge.script_read: Total 44.5 is moderate volume, not a shootout. TB +3.5 meets the dog-throws rule, so TB WR/TE/RB targets go up and PHI's lead back carries go up if PHI leads late. Blowout flag is off at 3.5, but a two-score PHI lead would still cut TB RB carries and PHI pass volume.
pro_edge.best_price: No two-sided price saved on any prop. Anchor no-vig N/A. Pinnacle, Circa and BetOnline are not in the pack, so there is no best price, no power-devig gap, and no edge-pts number. Listed numbers are 2025 season-to-date median stand-ins, not book lines.
pro_edge.lagging: No book consensus to diff. The lag that matters is that Egbuka 67.5, Shepard 39.5, Otton 12.5 and Irving receiving 33.5 are unadjusted medians and have not moved for Evans being Out.
pro_edge.sleepers: Out: Mike Evans (TB WR, hamstring), same-position teammates Egbuka and Shepard, plus Godwin if he is active. Godwin is Questionable and absent from the weeks 1-3 target list. Also Out: Christian Izien (TB S). Doubtful: Adoree' Jackson (PHI CB). Questionable, not treated as out: Mayfield, Wirfs, Godwin, Logan Hall.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Evans is out and his 9.3 targets per game are gone, Shepard is already a 15-target, 10.2 YPT piece, and the unadjusted median stand-in is only 39.5, so a +3.5 dog pass script should clear that number if Mayfield plays.
edge_players.must_be_true: Mayfield is active and not limited to checkdowns; Shepard's route share holds or rises with Evans out; Godwin does not return and take the intermediate targets; TB is throwing because the game stays within a score.
edge_players.kills_it: Mayfield inactive or biceps-limited; Godwin active and featured; PHI brackets Shepard and funnels to Irving; the 80-yard game was a one-play spike and his real role stays 34-39; uncharted wind at an outdoor 1pm kick kills the pass game.

matchup.source: PHI middle YPA 6.67 on 21 attempts is the softest zone; CB Adoree' Jackson Doubtful (groin) on the official pre-game report. Pass defense is not a sieve (about 6.0 YPA overall), so this is a mild matchup plus a volume edge, not a coverage feast.

scheme_fit.source: TB weeks 1-3 targets: Shepard 15/153/154 air behind only Evans (28) and Egbuka (21). Evans Out removes the 28-target WR; Godwin has no listed targets, so Shepard is a real absorber, not a one-route extra.

script.source: TB +3.5 and implied total 20.5. Dog at 3.5+ throws more, so WR targets rise. Survives the base script; dies on the Mayfield-stall flip, so it is health-dependent.

form_trend.source: Prop last games 39, 34, 80. Only the 80 clears 39.5. Median equals the stand-in. The 80 is a spike risk under step 5, which is why this is flagged rather than sized.

primary_defender.who: Not charted. Only listed PHI DB injury is CB Adoree' Jackson (Doubtful, groin). Softest PHI zone is middle (6.67 YPA, 21 att) if Shepard works inside.
primary_defender.source: Pack injury report and PHI location splits. No coverage chart, no snap/alignment data.

edge_players.pro_edge_support: Sleeper: Evans Out, Shepard recyds 39.5 is an unadjusted median with no-vig N/A, so the number has not moved. Script support is the +3.5 dog target bump. Edge pts, gate pts and stake are not computable. CLV blank pre-kick.

data_check.notes: No projection, no sims, no Pinnacle no-vig. model_p 0.58 is a hand read, not a 3-sim output, and is kept under the 70% suspicion line. Old-role form disagrees (Shepard cleared 39.5 in 1 of 3; the 51 mean is the 80-yard spike). That flags a strong role-change read (Evans' 28 targets removed) and does not cut it. Dropped lean: Egbuka recyds over 67.5, because 67.5 is above his 60.3 mean, only 1 of 3 games cleared, and the Evans targets have to land on him. Dropped lean: Irving rushyds over 66.5, because PHI's 5.06 YPC bleed fights the dog script, his own YPC is 3.11, Wirfs is questionable, and 1 of 3 games cleared 66.5. Dropped lean: Barkley rushyds over 60.5, because TB allows 3.79 YPC and only 6 runs of 10+, Hurts has 26 carries, and 60/88/46 does not clear 60.5 often. No live weather, final inactives, or coverage chart.

market_rung_price: Main-line stand-in only, no stored price and no alt rung: Sterling Shepard recyds over 39.5. Volume edge from vacated targets maps to receiving yards. Do not take a shorter alt. No -250 or plus price exists to grade, so this is not sized.
pre_mortem: It's Monday and Shepard under 39.5 lost the over. Mayfield's biceps knocked him into a checkdown game or out of it, so Evans' targets never became Shepard yards. Godwin was active and the staff fed him and Otton. PHI, knowing Evans was out, doubled the remaining receivers and lived with Irving screens. The 80-yard game was a busted coverage that did not repeat, and 39 and 34 were the real role. The 39.5 figure was a median stand-in, not a book price, so there was no market edge once the inactive sheet hit.
slip_story: One story: Evans-out TB pass funnel in a +3.5 dog script. Shepard over 39.5 is the only leg that clears the read. Do not force Egbuka, a total under, a Barkley rush over, or an Irving rush over into the same slip; those need a different health or run script. No TD legs and no second market on Shepard. No stake: no price, no model gate, proposal withheld.
